# pltr osdk

Generate OSDK TypeScript packages for apps from the pltr profile (needs Node.js and npm).

1 command. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

### pltr osdk generate

Generate an OSDK TypeScript package for an app, from the pltr profile.

`pltr osdk generate --ontology TEXT --out PATH [OPTIONS]`

- `--ontology` TEXT (required): Ontology API name or RID (ri.ontology.main.ontology.<id>); find it with 'pltr ontology list'.
- `--out` PATH (required): Directory for the package: it is written to <out>/<package-name>, e.g. ./osdk/@app/sdk.
- `--object-type` TEXT (repeatable): Object type API name to include.
- `--action-type` TEXT (repeatable): Action type API name to include (include the object types its parameters take).
- `--query-type` TEXT (repeatable): Query (function) API name to include, optionally as name:version.
- `--link-type` TEXT (repeatable): Link type to include, as ObjectType.linkApiName (both object types must be included); without it objects have no links.
- `--interface-type` TEXT (repeatable): Interface type API name to include.
- `--package-name` TEXT (default: @app/sdk): npm name of the generated package.
- `--package-version` TEXT (default: 0.0.1): Version of the generated package.
- `--replace`: Generate a package that exists already again (to change its types, or after the ontology changed).
- SDK: `ontologies.Ontology.get`
